Wholesale Plastic Wine Glasses for Events and Hospitality

Moulded wine glasses and goblets in PS, PP, AS and acrylic — the volume alternative to breakable stemware.

Request wine glasses pricing Custom logo options

About this range

This is the broadest range in the catalogue: classic stemmed wine glasses from 7.1 oz tasting pours up to 20.3 oz generous pours, in polystyrene for everyday volume, polypropylene for a softer hand feel, and acrylic for the closest visual match to real glass. Every mould is our own, so rim thickness, base weight and box counts are consistent order after order — which matters when you are promising a venue or a retail chain the same glass next season.

Wine Glasses — buyer questions

MOQ is held per SKU/model and per order route for this range — a standard bulk order, a decorated order and a gift-box build can each carry a different minimum.

What does the Wine Glasses range include?

This range holds 13 items, specified in PS, PP, AS and acrylic. Orders come most often from bars and restaurants, event caterers and retail and e-commerce brands. Each product card states the shape, capacity, material and case pack for that SKU, and the specification table on each product page is the record the quotation is issued against.

See the range · Request a quote

What wine glasses styles are available for wholesale?

The Wine Glasses range covers a selection of shapes, capacities and materials. Review the product cards for the available shape, capacity, material, case pack and customization route for each SKU.

All wine glass SKUs

What is the MOQ for this wine glasses model?

MOQ is maintained by SKU/model, not by the Wine Glasses category. A standard bulk order, logo decoration and a custom gift-box build can have different minimums for the same model. Check the MOQ shown on the selected product page, or submit the SKU, quantity, decoration, packaging and destination for a model-specific quotation.

How MOQ works

Which logo methods can be used on wine glasses?

The suitable logo method depends on the surface, artwork, decoration area, colour count, expected durability and order quantity. Upload the artwork with the selected SKU so we can confirm the feasible options for that model.

Logo decoration guide

Can wine glasses be supplied in gift-ready packaging?

Gift-ready packaging is assessed as part of the SKU configuration. Confirm the number of pieces per set, insert style, outer box, logo treatment and any bag or greeting-card requirement in the quotation request.

Gift box packaging guide

What should I check before ordering wine glasses for export?

Confirm the item dimensions, material, case pack, packaging protection, destination and delivery date. These inputs determine the shipping configuration and the quotation basis.

Import duty guide

Can I order a sample before a bulk order?

Sample availability and cost are confirmed for the selected SKU and customization route. Include the SKU, artwork, packaging requirement and destination when requesting a sample.

Request a sample
